title: Muñɗo mo ƴaañii
intro: E nder defte daartol annabaaɓe, ko seeɗa tan muñnoo hono ndee ɗoo majjere luggiɗnde e caɗeele ɓalliije e goonɗinal ngal diwtataa. Daartol ngol limre ko jannde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi e muñal e hoolaare e hakkille Alla. Hol ooɗoo ruuhu?
clues: Mi suɓaama e Alla ngam yettinde nelal, kono jarribo am ɓurngo mawnude wonaa e jaɓde, kono ko e musiiba keeriiɗo.
Jawdi am e jawdi am e ɓiɓɓe am ndaaraa e am, gooto caggal goɗɗo.
Ɓanndu am ina ɓuuɓna, mi heddii tan so wonaa ballal jom suudu am.
Miɗo wulla Joomiraawo am, miɗo jaɓa torra am, miɗo ɗaɓɓa yurmeende makko.
Mi yamiraama yo mi fiy leydi e koyngal am, ɓuuɓol ɓuuɓngol yalti.
Alla artiri cellal am, rokki mi galle keso, haa ɓurti jawdi ndi njoginoomi ko adii.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
